entities.summary: Mavroudis (Makis) Voridis is a Greek far-right politician with the New Democracy. He was previously involved in far-right politics and associated with dictator Georgios Papadopoulos. Makis Voridis was a legal figures from Athens (b. 1964-08-23, Athens). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
